But in the case of Vast Wealth, there is a problem. The card tells
you to "equip with the first piece of equipment on your library". If you
can't equip with it, won't the action fizzle?

David Pontes

8[

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. If you cannot equip with the selected card, then the action fizzles
(and the selected card is burned). [RTR 960221]

Note that if the only reason that you cannot equip with the equipment
is that it costs more pool than you have, then you are ousted (the
action doesn't "fizzle" just to keep you in the game). [RTR 941006]


